status: Preserved verifier-entry failure before any geometry jobs
cause: The verifier validated every same-source historical manifest before selecting later outputs. A targeted front export was overwritten by a subsequent full export with a different file hash. A valid latest manifest exists, but the older row triggered the gate first.
correction: Select the latest source-current manifest per role, then enforce its exact current file hash. Never fall back to an older manifest when the latest row fails.
